svg.title: Calibration: independent verification and filter selection
svg.desc: Four panels show forward calibration and a fitted line, independent static verification under normal and drift conditions, step responses at 100 Hz, and plateau scatter versus threshold-crossing delay for three filter windows.

cc:Work.dc:title: Calibration: independent verification and filter selection
